record.title: Cybersecurity Standard Practice Guide — Artificial Intelligence Application Security Guidelines: Education
record.original_title: 网络安全标准实践指南——人工智能应用安全指引 教育
record.issuing_body: National Cybersecurity Standardization Technical Committee (TC260) Secretariat
record.summary: Education guide in TC260's AI application security guidelines, used with the general part (TC260-PG-20268A). Educational institutions are to manage AI use by role, age and stage with whitelists, algorithm filing and security assessment, set up ethics review, and keep AI in an assisting role whose outputs people check, with notice, objection, human review and appeal channels. Minors need age-appropriate defaults, guardian consent and supervised use. Rules for AI-assisted teaching, learning, research, management and assessment include emergency takeover, a ban on AI-generated project applications, papers or research reports, and no negative evaluation of individuals.
record.notes: Version v1.0-202609, released on 15 Sept 2026 with notice 网安秘字〔2026〕118号 together with the general provisions and the health and audiovisual guides. It applies to educational institutions, defined as education administrative departments and their affiliated units and schools of all levels and types. Primary school pupils are not to use open-ended content generation alone, and important decisions on students, staff, resources and degrees are not to execute AI conclusions directly. Drafting units include the Ministry of Education's Department of Science, Technology and Informatization and its Education Management Information Center. Annex A describes typical scenarios and their main risks.

verification.note: Stored from tc260.org.cn: the guide's PDF (version v1.0-202609) and the release notice 网安秘字〔2026〕118号 of 15 Sept 2026 with the four guides attached to it. Title, number, issuer, date and contents are confirmed from these; the summary follows the Chinese text. No English version was found.

judgment.status_reasoning: The TC260 Secretariat released the guide with notice 网安秘字〔2026〕118号 of 15 Sept 2026 (关于发布 ... 的通知, a release notice, not a call for comments); the cover carries a released version number (v1.0-202609) and no draft marking (征求意见稿). The preface describes practice guides as technical documents the TC260 Secretariat drafts and publishes to give practical guidance, so it is not binding; no later version is stored. Published (non-binding, current).
judgment.date_reasoning: The notice's posting date (发布时间) and signature date are both 15 Sept 2026.
judgment.scope_reasoning: AI-specific security guidance from TC260, the national cybersecurity standardisation committee, covering the full AI application life cycle: a government safety and risk-management guideline (AGENTS.md section 10, in with no note).
judgment.instrument_type_reasoning: TC260 practice guides are 'standard-related technical documents' giving practical guidance, not national standards; recorded as Guidelines / framework.
